# MoneyMaker

> Self-hosted alternative to RevenueCat. One backend for App Store (StoreKit 2), Google Play Billing and Stripe subscriptions: receipt validation, server notifications, entitlements, remote paywall offerings, metrics (MRR, churn, trials), outgoing signed webhooks. Base URL: https://moneymaker-io.web.app/v1

## Setup status (use it to know what is left)
`GET /v1/projects/{id}/setup` → `{ progress (0–1), next, steps: [{ id, title, done, optional, help }] }`. Steps auto-validate from real traffic (SDK call, Apple/Google notification received, Stripe webhook, first purchase). Human guide: https://moneymaker-io.web.app/guide

## Instructions for coding agents integrating MoneyMaker into an app

You need from the user: a PUBLIC key (`mm_pub_…`, safe to ship in apps) and the entitlement id to gate (default `premium`). The SECRET key (`mm_sk_…`) must never be put in an app binary — server-side only.

### iOS / macOS / watchOS (Swift, StoreKit 2)
1. Add Swift package: `https://github.com/amineprimesmr/moneymaker` → product `MoneyMaker`. Or copy `sdk/ios/Sources/MoneyMaker` into the project.
2. At launch (App init):
   ```swift
   import MoneyMaker
   MoneyMaker.configure(apiKey: "mm_pub_…", appUserID: currentUser?.id) // nil = anonymous
   ```
3. After sign-in: `try await MoneyMaker.shared.logIn(user.id)` (anonymous purchases are merged). On sign-out: `MoneyMaker.shared.logOut()`.
4. Gate features: `MoneyMaker.shared.isEntitled("premium")` (sync, cached, offline-safe). SwiftUI: observe `@ObservedObject var mm = MoneyMaker.shared` and read `mm.customerInfo`, or use `.requiresEntitlement("premium")`.
5. Paywall: `let offerings = try await MoneyMaker.shared.loadOfferings()`; `offerings.current?.packages` each has `.product` (StoreKit `Product`), `.localizedPrice`, `.hasFreeTrial`, `.metadata`. Buy: `try await MoneyMaker.shared.purchase(package)` → `.success(info) | .userCancelled | .pending`. Or present the drop-in `MoneyMakerPaywall(termsURL:privacyURL:)`.
6. Restore button: `try await MoneyMaker.shared.restorePurchases()`. Manage: `await MoneyMaker.shared.showManageSubscriptions()`.
7. Remove RevenueCat (`Purchases.configure`, `Purchases.shared.*`) and any custom StoreKit transaction listener — the SDK already listens to `Transaction.updates` and finishes transactions after server validation.

### Android (Kotlin, Play Billing 7)
1. Add `maven("https://jitpack.io")` to repositories and `implementation("com.github.amineprimesmr:moneymaker:1.0.1")` (brings `com.android.billingclient:billing-ktx:7.1.1`).
2. `MoneyMaker.configure(applicationContext, apiKey = "mm_pub_…", appUserId = user?.id)` in `Application.onCreate`.
3. `MoneyMaker.shared.logIn(id)` (suspend), `MoneyMaker.shared.isEntitled("premium")`, `MoneyMaker.shared.customerInfo` (StateFlow).
4. `val offerings = MoneyMaker.shared.loadOfferings()`; `MoneyMaker.shared.purchase(activity, offerings.current!!.packages.first())`. Purchases are verified and acknowledged by the server.
5. `MoneyMaker.shared.restorePurchases()`.

### Web / Stripe
- Checkout: `POST /v1/customers/{appUserId}/stripe/checkout` with public key, body `{ "priceId": "price_…", "successUrl": "https://…", "cancelUrl": "https://…" }` → `{ url }`. Redirect to url.
- Portal: `POST /v1/customers/{appUserId}/stripe/portal` body `{ "returnUrl": "https://…" }` → `{ url }`.
- Subscriptions created elsewhere are linked when `metadata.app_user_id` is set on the Stripe subscription or customer.

### Your own backend
- Check access: `GET /v1/customers/{appUserId}` with public or secret key → `{ activeEntitlements: ["premium"], entitlements: {...}, purchases: [...] }`.
- Receive events: configure webhook URLs in the dashboard. Each POST has header `MoneyMaker-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>` where `hex = HMAC_SHA256(signingSecret, t + "." + rawBody)`. Reject if older than 5 minutes. Event `type` ∈ INITIAL_PURCHASE, RENEWAL, TRIAL_STARTED, TRIAL_CONVERTED, CANCELLATION, UNCANCELLATION, EXPIRATION, BILLING_ISSUE, BILLING_RECOVERED, REFUND, REVOKED, PRODUCT_CHANGE, NON_RENEWING_PURCHASE, PAUSED, GRANT, TEST.

## Project setup by an agent (personal access token `mm_pat_…`)
- `POST /v1/projects` `{ "name": "MyApp", "appStoreAppId": "6400000000" (optional: pre-fills bundle id, Apple ID and ranking tracking), "googlePackageName": "com.myapp" (optional), "config": { "currency": "EUR", "entitlements": { "premium": ["com.myapp.monthly", "com.myapp.annual"] }, "apple": { "bundleId": "com.myapp", "appAppleId": 6400000000 }, "google": { "packageName": "com.myapp" } } }` → `{ projectId, publicKey, secretKey }` (secret shown once).
- `PATCH /v1/projects/{id}` `{ "config": { "offerings": { "default": { "packages": [ { "id": "annual", "productIds": { "app_store": "com.myapp.annual", "play_store": "annual", "stripe": "price_…" }, "metadata": { "badge": "-40%" } } ] } }, "currentOffering": "default", "webhooks": [ { "url": "https://api.myapp.com/moneymaker" } ] } }`
- `PUT /v1/projects/{id}/credentials` `{ "apple": { "issuerId", "keyId", "privateKey": "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----…" }, "google": { "serviceAccount": {…json…} }, "stripe": { "secretKey": "rk_live_…", "webhookSecret": "whsec_…" } }`
- `GET /v1/projects/{id}` → `endpoints.appleNotifications` (paste in App Store Connect → App Information → App Store Server Notifications V2, production and sandbox), `endpoints.googleRtdn` (Pub/Sub push subscription URL), `endpoints.stripeWebhook`.

## One-step store connections (secret key, PAT or dashboard session)
- Stripe: `POST /v1/projects/{id}/connect/stripe` `{ "secretKey": "sk_live_…" | "rk_live_…" }` → validates the key, creates the Stripe webhook endpoint automatically, imports every subscription and 12 months of paid invoices. Response: `{ account, livemode, importedSubscriptions, importedInvoices }`.
- App Store Connect: `POST /v1/projects/{id}/connect/appstore` `{ "issuerId", "keyId", "privateKey": "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----…", "appAppleId": "6400000000", "setNotificationUrl": true? }` (App Store Connect API key, App Manager role) → reads the app, imports subscription/IAP product ids into the first entitlement, starts ranking tracking, and points App Store Server Notifications V2 (production + sandbox) at MoneyMaker when the URL is empty or `setNotificationUrl: true`.
- Google Play: `POST /v1/projects/{id}/connect/google` `{ "packageName", "serviceAccount": {…} }` → verifies Play access, imports subscription ids, returns the Pub/Sub push endpoint for RTDN.

## Migrate from RevenueCat
`POST /v1/projects/{id}/import/revenuecat` `{ "secretKey": "sk_…", "appUserIds": ["uid1", …] (only for legacy v1 keys) }` → `{ jobId }`; poll `GET /v1/projects/{id}/import/{jobId}` → `{ status: queued|running|done|failed, result: { customers, purchases } }`. Imports current subscriptions and lifetime purchases (sandbox excluded). When the real store purchase later reaches MoneyMaker (SDK or notification) the imported copy is replaced, never double-counted. One-time payments (Checkout, Payment Links, charges) are imported and tracked too. Stripe customers are linked through metadata `app_user_id`, `firebaseUID`, `user_id` or `uid`.

## RevenueCat-compatible API (migrate a backend by changing base URL + key)
Base URL `https://moneymaker-io.web.app/v1/rc` (every route is also served without `/rc`, e.g. `/v1/subscribers/{id}`). Auth `Authorization: Bearer mm_pub_…` (public key, read + receipts + attributes, like RevenueCat's SDK key) or `mm_sk_…` (secret key, everything):
- `GET /v1/rc/v1/subscribers/{app_user_id}` → RevenueCat v1 `{ subscriber: { entitlements, subscriptions, non_subscriptions, subscriber_attributes, … } }`.
- `DELETE /v1/rc/v1/subscribers/{app_user_id}` (secret) → `{ app_user_id, deleted: true }` (GDPR).
- `POST /v1/rc/v1/subscribers/{app_user_id}/attributes` `{ "attributes": { "$email": { "value": "…", "updated_at_ms": … } } }` (null/"" deletes).
- `GET /v1/rc/v1/subscribers/{app_user_id}/offerings` → `{ current_offering_id, offerings: [{ identifier, description, metadata, packages: [{ identifier, platform_product_identifier }] }] }` (store chosen from `X-Platform: ios|android|stripe`).
- `POST /v1/rc/v1/subscribers/{app_user_id}/alias` `{ "new_app_user_id": "…" }`.
- `POST /v1/rc/v1/receipts` `{ app_user_id, fetch_token, product_ids?, price?, currency?, attributes? }`: Apple = StoreKit 2 signed transaction (JWS); Google = purchase token (`X-Platform: android`); Stripe = `sub_…` or `cs_…`. Base64 StoreKit 1 receipts → 422 `legacy_receipt_unsupported`.
- `POST /v1/rc/v1/subscribers/{app_user_id}/entitlements/{entitlement}/promotional` (secret) `{ "duration": "daily" … "lifetime" }` or `{ "end_time_ms": … }` (stacks like RevenueCat).
- `POST /v1/rc/v1/subscribers/{app_user_id}/entitlements/{entitlement}/revoke_promotionals` (secret).
- `POST …/subscriptions/{product_id}/revoke|refund|defer` → 501 `not_supported` (do it in the store console; notifications sync the result).
- Webhooks in RevenueCat format: `PATCH` config `{ "webhooks": [{ "id": "rc", "url": "https://…", "format": "revenuecat" }] }` and set the header your receiver checks with `PUT …/credentials { "webhookAuthorization": { "rc": "Bearer <secret>" } }`. Bodies are `{ api_version, event: { type, app_user_id, product_id, period_type, price, is_trial_conversion, … } }`.
During a migration, read both RevenueCat and MoneyMaker and keep the entitlement expiring last (old app versions still buy through RevenueCat).

## Integrations
`PUT /v1/projects/{id}/credentials` `{ "integrations": { "slackWebhookUrl", "discordWebhookUrl", "mixpanelToken", "amplitudeApiKey", "segmentWriteKey", "posthog": { "apiKey", "host"? } }, "appsflyer": { "devKey" } }` (null removes one). AppsFlyer app ids: `PATCH` config `{ "integrations": { "appsflyer": { "appId": "id123", "androidAppId": "com.app" } } }`; the app must set attributes `$appsflyerId` (+ `$idfa`, `$idfv` when allowed). Events are sent as `mm_<event_type>` (Mixpanel/Amplitude/Segment/PostHog) and `rc_*_event` (AppsFlyer, RevenueCat-compatible names).

## App Store intelligence (rankings, alerts, ratings, reviews)
- Search: `GET /v1/appstore/search?term=whoop&country=fr`.
- Track apps (own or competitors, max 25): `PUT /v1/projects/{id}/appstore` `{ "apps": [{ "appId": "933944389", "own": false }] }`. First scan starts immediately (25 biggest markets), then hourly; every storefront (177) is refreshed at least every 6 h. Charts: top free / paid / grossing, overall and in the app's category.
- `GET /v1/projects/{id}/appstore` (summary: countriesRanked, bestRank, rating, topRankings) · `GET …/appstore/{appId}/ranks` (rank, prevRank, bestRank, history per country/chart) · `GET …/appstore/{appId}/ratings` (per country) · `GET …/appstore/{appId}/reviews?country=FR&rating=1` · `POST …/appstore/{appId}/reviews/{reviewId}/translate { "target": "fr" }`.
- Alerts: `GET /v1/projects/{id}/alerts`, all businesses `GET /v1/alerts` (PAT). Types: NEW_COUNTRY, TOP_100, TOP_10, TOP_1, JUMP (+10), DROP (−15), LEFT_CHART. Delivered to Slack/Discord and to your webhooks as `RANKING_<TYPE>`.

## Customer Center
Self-service subscription screen (like RevenueCat Customer Center): active subscriptions, manage/cancel, restore, refund, contact support, cancellation survey + retention offer.
- Config (PATCH /v1/projects/:pid with `config.customerCenter`, null to remove): `{ enabled, supportEmail?, retentionOffer?: { productIdApple?, offerIdApple?, googleOfferId?, message }, survey: { question, options: string[1..10] } }`.
- GET /v1/customer-center (public key) → that config (`{enabled:false}` if unset).
- POST /v1/customers/:id/customer-center/feedback (public key) `{ reason, comment?, action }`, action ∈ cancel | accepted_offer | refund | dismissed | contact_support. Stored in `projects/{pid}/feedback` and sent to integrations as event `CUSTOMER_CENTER_FEEDBACK`.
- iOS (SwiftUI, iOS 16+): `.moneyMakerCustomerCenter(isPresented: $show)` or `MoneyMakerCustomerCenter()`. Cancel flow: survey → retention offer (alert) → system manage-subscriptions sheet. Apple promotional offers must be signed server-side: pass `signOffer: { productID, offerID in PromotionalOfferSignature(...) }`; without it the offer message is shown only. Refunds use `Transaction.beginRefundRequest`. Also `MoneyMaker.shared.loadCustomerCenterConfig()` / `sendCustomerCenterFeedback(reason:comment:action:)` for custom UIs.
- Android: `MoneyMaker.shared.showCustomerCenter(activity)` opens Play subscription management (deep link with sku + package); `customerCenterConfig()`, `sendCustomerCenterFeedback(reason, action, comment)`.

## Reference
- Metrics: `GET /v1/projects/{id}/metrics?days=30` — MRR, ARR, MRR movement (new/churned/net), active subs/trials/customers, revenue (gross, refunds, net, new vs renewal) by day/country/store/product, active subscribers by country, ARPPU, ARPU, LTV, refund rate, monthly churn, trial conversion (overall and per product), previous-period comparison, daily history. All businesses: `GET /v1/overview` (PAT).
- Refund Control (App Store): set `config.refundControl` = `{ "enabled": true, "preference": "decline" | "grant" | "none", "customerConsented": true }` via `PATCH /v1/projects/{id}` config. When Apple sends a `CONSUMPTION_REQUEST` notification, MoneyMaker answers immediately (Apple deadline 12 h) with App Store Server API v2 `PUT /inApps/v2/transactions/consumption/{transactionId}` (sandbox host for sandbox notifications), using the In-App Purchase key from `PUT /v1/projects/{id}/credentials` `apple`. Body: `customerConsented`, `deliveryStatus` (DELIVERED if the purchase is known, else UNDELIVERED_OTHER), `sampleContentProvided: false`, `consumptionPercentage` (milliunits: subscriptions = elapsed share of current period, non-consumables = 100000, consumables omitted), `refundPreference` (decline → DECLINE, grant → GRANT_FULL, none → omitted). Nothing is sent unless `enabled` and `customerConsented` are true (Apple requires the customer's consent). Signals stored with each request: accountTenure bucket (from customer firstSeenAt), totalSpentMicros, refundsCount, entitlementActive. `GET /v1/projects/{id}/refund-requests?sandbox=true?` → `{ config, stats: { total, sent, skipped, failed, pending, refunded, declined, refundRate }, requests }`; outcomes are filled by `REFUND` / `REFUND_DECLINED` notifications.
- Cohorts: `GET /v1/projects/{id}/cohorts?months=12` — monthly cohorts by first payment: subscription retention (annual payments cover 12 months) and cumulative revenue per customer.
- CSV export: `GET /v1/projects/{id}/export/customers|transactions|events` (secret key or session).
- Customers: `GET /v1/projects/{id}/customers`, `GET /v1/projects/{id}/customers/{appUserId}`, grant: `POST …/customers/{appUserId}/grant { entitlement, days? }` (omit days = lifetime, 0 = revoke).
- Events: `GET /v1/projects/{id}/events`. Transactions: `GET /v1/projects/{id}/transactions`.
- Errors: JSON `{ error, message }` with HTTP 400/401/403/404/5xx.
- Dashboard: https://moneymaker-io.web.app
